User.title: User Profile
User.description: Stores consolidated astro-numerology profile and premium parameters of the registered users.

DreamLog.title: Celestial Dream Interpretation
DreamLog.description: Holds the history of dreams interpreted for a active user profile.

interpretation.description: Elias angelical and cosmic reading details

AstralExtraMap.title: Extra Astrological Sincronic Map
